name: How long does it take to replace a failed window seal?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a failed window seal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The actual replacement of an insulated glass unit (IGU) with a failed seal is typically a quick process, often taking less than an hour per window once the new unit is fabricated. However, the overall timeline depends on the lead time for ordering the custom-sized glass, which can range from a few days to several weeks. Your contractor can provide a more precise estimate based on current material availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: The replacement itself is quick, but the overall time depends on glass fabrication lead times, which can vary.
